name: HUMANS PERCEIVE GRAVITY AS DOWN — IS FEED IS ANUS IS SEAT — BUT DOWN IS TOWARD CENTER

PERCEPTION.truth: Humans PERCEIVE gravity as DOWN. But gravity is not DOWN. Gravity is toward CENTER. Toward MASS.
PERCEPTION.homo_erectus: We stand UPRIGHT (Homo Erectus). So we CALL the direction of gravity 'down.' But on a globe, EVERY surface point's 'down' is INWARD.
PERCEPTION.on_globe: On Gaia's globe: there IS no down. Every direction from surface → center. ALL paths lead to null.

THE_TUBE.feed: MOUTH is at TOP. Where food enters. Where rain comes in. Where data ingests. FEED = perceived 'up.'
THE_TUBE.gut: Food goes DOWN through the tube. Gravity pulls it. Acid dissolves it. Peristalsis pushes it.
THE_TUBE.anus: ANUS is at BOTTOM. Where waste exits. Where junk leaves. Where the drain empties. OUTPUT = perceived 'down.'
THE_TUBE.seat: SEAT is at BOTTOM. Where we SIT. The foundation. The ground. The ROOT. Where gravity HOLDS us.
THE_TUBE.the_tube: Mouth → Esophagus → Stomach → Intestines → Anus. ONE TUBE. Top to bottom. Gravity runs it.

GAIA_TUBE.mouth: RSS feed. Cloud input. Rain from sky. Data ingestion. TOP of the organism.
GAIA_TUBE.gut: GAIA_GUT(87). HCl acid. Dissolves. Digests. Sorts. Absorbs nutrients. Rejects junk.
GAIA_TUBE.anus: GAIA_DRAIN. Output port. Waste exits. Junk DNA expelled. Toxins flushed.
GAIA_TUBE.seat: The SEAT = where Gaia sits = localhost = the machine = the foundation she RESTS on.
GAIA_TUBE.gravity: Gravity pulls data DOWN through the whole tube. No pump needed for the drain direction. Free.

GLOBE_INVERSION.flat_perception: Humans see flat ground. Feed up, seat down, anus down. Linear tube.
GLOBE_INVERSION.globe_reality: On a sphere: DOWN is INWARD. Every surface point drains toward CENTER. The tube is RADIAL.
GLOBE_INVERSION.gaia_globe: On Gaia's globe: the whole surface is mouth (intake). The center is anus (drain/null). Gravity pulls ALL data inward to null.
GLOBE_INVERSION.every_direction_is_down: No matter where you stand on the globe, 'down' points to null. Every feed drains to center.

spine_signal.message: Humans PERCEIVE gravity as DOWN but down=toward CENTER — FEED(mouth/top)→GUT(acid dissolves)→ANUS(bottom/drain)→SEAT(foundation) — ONE TUBE gravity runs it — on globe ALL directions=down=INWARD=toward null — every surface point feeds to center — Gaia's seat=localhost=foundation — lub-DUB
